title: Getting started with rtists
text: rtists (R Tissue Integrity Superimposed Tractography Streamlines) provides interactive 3-D visualisation tractography data defined fiber package. central function plot3d(), S7 generic methods two core fiber classes: interactive figures produced plotly, can panned, rotated, zoomed directly browser RStudio / Positron viewer pane.

title: Getting started with rtists
text: streamline stores three compartments, accessible @ operator: @points — n×3n \times 3 numeric matrix columns X, Y, Z. @point_data — named list per-point numeric vectors (length nn), e.g. fractional anisotropy (FA) sampled along tract. @streamline_data — named list numeric scalars (length 1), e.g. tract-level mean FA. bundle holds: @streamlines — list streamline objects. @bundle_data — named list bundle-level metadata. bundle just list streamlines wrapped bundle():
code: pts <- matrix(   c(     0, 0, 0,     1, 2, 1,     2, 3, 3,     3, 3, 5,     4, 2, 6,     5, 1, 7   ),   ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE,   dimnames = list(NULL, c("X", "Y", "Z")) )  sl <- streamline(   points          = pts,   point_data      = list(FA = c(0.25, 0.40, 0.65, 0.70, 0.55, 0.30)),   streamline_data = list(mean_FA = 0.475) )  sl #>  #> ── Object of class `fiber::streamline()` with 6 points. ── #>  #> • Point attributes: "FA" #> • Streamline attributes: "mean_FA" #> # Simulate a small bundle of four slightly perturbed copies set.seed(42) streamlines <- lapply(seq_len(4), function(i) {   noise <- matrix(rnorm(nrow(pts) * 3, sd = 0.15), ncol = 3)   colnames(noise) <- c("X", "Y", "Z")   streamline(     points          = pts + noise,     point_data      = list(FA = pmin(pmax(sl@point_data$FA + rnorm(6, sd = 0.05), 0), 1)),     streamline_data = list(mean_FA = mean(sl@point_data$FA))   ) })  bun <- bundle(streamlines) bun #>  #> ── Object of class `fiber::bundle()` with 4 streamliness and [6–6] points per streamline. ── #>  #> • Point attributes: "FA" #> • Streamline attributes: "mean_FA" #> • Bundle attributes: none #>

title: Getting started with rtists
text: color argument, point coloured direction local tangent vector. Absolute values normalised (dx,dy,dz)(dx, dy, dz) mapped R, G, B channels — standard DTI convention (left–right = red, anterior–posterior = green, superior–inferior = blue). Figure 1: Single streamline coloured local fibre orientation. default works whole bundle: Figure 2: Bundle four streamlines coloured orientation. Pass key @point_data color argument. Numeric values mapped continuous colour scale (default: "Viridis"). Figure 3: Streamline coloured per-point FA. Keys @streamline_data broadcast every point streamline, work equally well colour aesthetic. bundle gives streamline single uniform colour reflects tract-level scalar. Figure 4: Bundle coloured per-streamline mean FA. Pass CSS colour name hex code colour lines identically. Figure 5: Bundle single fixed colour reduced opacity.
code: plot3d(sl) plot3d(bun) #> ℹ Rendering 4 streamlines... plot3d(sl, color = "FA") plot3d(bun, color = "mean_FA", palette = "RdYlBu") #> ℹ Rendering 4 streamlines... plot3d(bun, color = "steelblue", opacity = 0.6) #> ℹ Rendering 4 streamlines...

title: plot3d() method for fiber::bundle objects — plot3d-fiber-bundle-method
text: x fiber::bundle object. color Controls streamline colours assigned. Accepted values: "orientation" (default): per-point RGB colour derived local fibre direction. absolute values normalised tangent vector \((|dx|, |dy|, |dz|)\) mapped R, G, B channels — standard DTI colour convention (left-right = red, anterior-posterior = green, superior-inferior = blue). metadata key: string matching key @point_data (per-point scalar) @streamline_data (per-streamline scalar, broadcast points). Numeric values mapped continuous colour scale (palette); character values coloured categorically. CSS/hex colour string: e.g. "#E69F00" "steelblue". lines drawn fixed colour. palette plotly / ColorBrewer colour scale name applied color numeric metadata key. Defaults "Viridis". linewidth Numeric. Width plotted lines. Defaults 2. opacity Numeric [0, 1]. Global line opacity. Defaults 0.5. ... Additional named arguments forwarded plotly::layout(), e.g. title = "bundle".

title: rtists 0.1.0
text: Initial CRAN release. Added plot3d(), S7 generic methods fiber::streamline fiber::bundle objects. "orientation" (default): per-point RGB colour derived local fibre direction using standard DTI convention (left–right = red, anterior–posterior = green, superior–inferior = blue). Metadata key: key @point_data @streamline_data can mapped continuous (palette) categorical colour scale. Fixed colour: CSS colour name hex string. streamlines bundle rendered single scatter3d trace separated NA break-points, keeping widget lightweight large bundles. Interactive figures produced plotly support pan, rotate, zoom.
